title: Implement Founder-selected JESTER Color & Design System v1
goal: Implement Founder-selected JESTER Color & Design System v1 with vivid Carrot Orange primary accent, dark-label accessibility compliance (5.82:1), warm paper surfaces, support sage, peach insights, and updated shared components across representative screens (Home, Discover, Person/Why, Compare, Register, VisualLab).
constraints: Preserve all existing application behavior and authorization boundaries.
Do not touch or revert uncommitted backend canonical changes.
Do not redesign or recolor the three-point JESTER logo.
Ensure WCAG AA contrast: dark #222630 text on bright #FF7A2F primary button (5.82:1); no white normal text on #FF7A2F.
Preserve Georgian-first text; no English copy leakage into Georgian UI.
No autonomous git push or automatic commit.
acceptance_criteria: Token architecture mapped and implemented in frontend/src/ui/tokens/colors.ts, frontend/tailwind.config.js, and frontend/src/index.css.
Primary button uses #FF7A2F with dark label #222630 meeting WCAG AA contrast ratio >= 4.5:1.
Shared UI components (Button, Card, Input, Badge) updated to use semantic tokens.
Representative screens (Home, Discover, Person/Why, Compare, Register) migrated to new design system.
VisualLab updated and verified for design tokens and accessible component states.
TypeScript and frontend build succeed cleanly (npm run build -> exit code 0).
Existing backend tests pass cleanly (pytest -> exit code 0).
